Average Realtor Agency Pricing and Packages

When looking at realtor agency pricing, most agents find themselves choosing between DIY efforts and professional management. Typically, a comprehensive strategy ranges from $1,000 to over $5,000 per month depending on the volume of leads required. Partnering with a specialized team like ITZ Digital real estate experts allows you to leverage industry-specific knowledge to lower your cost-per-acquisition.

Breaking Down Realtor Lead Gen Cost

A significant portion of any budget is the realtor lead gen cost. High-quality lead generation services focus on intent. In 2026, costs vary based on the platform:
  • Social Media Ads: $15–$40 per lead.
  • High-Intent Search Leads: $50–$150 per lead.
  • Referral Networks: 25%–35% of the closing commission.

Maximizing ROI with Specialized Digital Strategies

To keep your marketing sustainable, you must balance immediate results with long-term growth. Utilizing Google Ads for real estate ensures your name appears when buyers are actively searching in your local area. Meanwhile, investing in local SEO for realtors builds an organic foundation that reduces your reliance on paid ads over time.
